## Review checklist

- [ ] I ran `node scripts/validate-curriculum.mjs`.
- [ ] Claims and external materials are sourced and licensing is checked.
- [ ] Examples use synthetic data and contain no secrets or personal information.
- [ ] Provider-specific content is optional and labeled.
- [ ] Accessibility and the lesson assessment have been reviewed.
